name: dev-workflows
description: Engineering-workflow plugins for Claude Code: prompt refining, PR lifecycle, ticket grooming, debugging, worktrees, and context continuity.

plugins.name: prompt
plugins.description: Turn a rough prompt into a repo-grounded spec with entry/exit criteria and guardrails, gated behind your review.

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: PR lifecycle: /pr:ready drives a PR to approved; /pr:review reviews a diff against a house checklist.

plugins.name: ticket
plugins.description: Groom a vague bug report or thread into a well-formed Linear issue (/ticket:groom).

plugins.name: debug
plugins.description: Debugging lifecycle: incident triage, prod-error repro, flaky-test diagnosis, house postmortems (/debug:triage, :repro, :flaky, :rca).

plugins.name: wt
plugins.description: Session worktree lifecycle: create from latest origin/main and enter (/wt:new), gated wrap-up with PR-merged check (/wt:done).

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: Feature-work document pipeline: /build:prd, /build:hld, /build:spec — quiz + internal research + marked ambiguity + publish gate (Notion or markdown).

plugins.name: ctx
plugins.description: Context continuity: PreCompact/SessionStart hooks steer every compaction; /ctx:save and /ctx:resume for durable state across /clear and restarts.
